assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: blank paper quest notice, a resizable fantasy game UI background.
Reference image role: style and material reference only; generate a NEW design, do not overwrite it. Match its polished hand-painted stationery, soft paper texture, warm pale reading surface and flat straight-on view.
Composition: square sheet fills 98% of square canvas with only a 1% genuinely transparent margin outside. All distinctive details confined to outermost 8% edge strips and corners. The central 84% is completely empty, pale, low contrast, for character art and Japanese quest text overlaid later. No printed text, no lines, no symbols or objects in the center. Complete uncropped sheet, perfectly front-facing with no perspective. Designed for nine-slice scaling: edge strips stretch, corner ornaments keep their shape. No environment, no desk, no characters, no envelope, no quill, no watermark.
Design: honey ivory parchment notice, softly curled short upper-left and lower-right tips, warm ochre weathered edges, a tiny amber wax seal at extreme lower-left corner with a simple sun emblem. An old-fashioned friendly village scroll sheet, with a large flat blank center. Keep curls very shallow within the 8% corner strip.
